name: Historicon
blurb: HMGS's flagship historical-miniatures wargaming convention, moving to the Lancaster County Convention Center in 2027, with hundreds of participation games and hobby classes.

editions.evidence: Dedicated /historicon-2027 page text: 'Historicon 2027 will be at the Lancaster County Convention Center on July 21-25, 2027.' Homepage confirms: 'Future Historicons 2027 - July 21-25 - small battles with BIG IMPACTS!'

notes: The last two editions (2024-2025) were held in Fredericksburg, VA ('our second year in Fredericksburg' per the homepage's 2025 recap), so the batch's Lancaster/PA placement looked suspect at first, but the official /historicon-2027 page explicitly states the 2027 edition returns to the Lancaster County Convention Center -- the given place was correct for this specific edition. This is a historical-miniatures wargaming convention (participation games, tournaments, hobby classes, War College lectures) with no celebrity-guest program of the comic-con kind, so guests is 'none' rather than 'none-yet'. 2028 (July 19-23) and 2029 (July 18-22) are also already announced on the homepage but both start after the 2027-12-31 window cutoff, so they were left out per the rules.
